subject: reasoning
question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the below equation mathematically correct?

26 - 13 + 39 ÷ 117 × 24 = 31
solution: Here, we use the BODMAS table given below: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f17fe402f98bb01e6c434026861e42229a2db5fdddb9ac339c012f7a2b73afa8.png] Given: ⇒ 26 - 13 + 39 ÷ 117 × 24 = 31 (1) **× and ÷** ⇒ 26 - 13 + 39 ÷ 117 × 24 = 31 After changing the signs: ⇒ 26 - 13 + 39 × __**117 ÷ 24**__ Apply BODMAS rule: ⇒ 26 - 13 + __**39 × 4.87**__ ⇒ 26 - 13 + 190.25 ⇒ 216.125 - 13 = 203.125 Here, the equation is not satisfied.
